sentences.text: The learned counsel for the Applicant submitted that the Applicant has no role in the matter and the offence under Section 328 of IPC may not be made out.

4. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor has placed reliance on the decision of this Court in Vinod Ramnath Gupta V/s. State of Maharashtra1, which was a case of seizure of Gutka in order to submit that in such a case the offence under Section 328 of IPC can be made out.
5.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The learned Additional Public Prosecutor to take detailed instructions about the status of the investigation and need for custodial interrogation.

ORDER (i) In the event of his arrest in connection with investigation of Crime No.542 of 2021 registered with Jail Road Police Station, the applicant shall be released on bail on executing a P.R. Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/-with one or two solvent sureties in the like amount.

(ii) The Applicant shall attend the Investigating Officer on 17, 18 and 19 January 2022 between 11.00 1 2020 SCC Onlin Bom 9230 N.S. Kamble page 2 of 3 30-aba-17-2022 a.m. to 1.00 p.m. and as and when required, by the Investigating Officer.
(iii) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence/witnesses.
(iv) This order shall remain in force till next date.

C.V. BHADANG, J.
